notes: Systemic: (1) The EUR-Lex bodies are as-published original texts, so later repeals (2006/66 -> 2023/1542; 78/2009 & 661/2009 -> 2019/2144; 2000/53 -> 2026/1738) are invisible and status stays 'in-force' wrongly; recommend a supersession pass over all eu-* records. (2) effective_date mixes adoption dates (most records, e.g. 2018/858 = 2018-05-30 whereas it applies from 2020-09-01) with other values; define convention. (3) Two EUR-Lex fetch failures (REACH, 2017/1151) produced junk bodies/summaries/titles. (4) Grounded un_equivalent lists appear to be UN Regs merely cited in the body (R85, R117, R120, 65 regs in 2018/858), not counterparts. (5) Reg 715/2007 itself remains in force until repealed by Euro 7 (2024/1257) effective 1 July 2030 (search snippet) - status correct; 2006/40 remains in force (not repealed by F-gas 2024/573). No findings for 2006/40 and 715/2007 beyond that; 2009/78 UN R127 equivalent is correct; 540/2014 summary correct.
